newsitem.title: USA: Burlington adds chairman's post to Krebs.
newsitem.headline: Burlington adds chairman's post to Krebs.

text.p: Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp said Thursday it named its president and chief executive officer, Robert Krebs, to the additional post of chairman of the board.
In addition, Krebs will also be chairman of the board's executive committee, the company said.
The additional positions become effective after the company's annual meeting on April 17, it said.

Daniel Davison, the company's current chairman, will not stand for reelection when his term expires, it said. Ben Love, current chairman of the board's executive committee, will also not stand for reelection, it said.
Both Davison and Love have reached the company's mandatory age for retirement, it said.

Burlington Northern's merger with Santa Fe Pacific Corp became effective in September, creating one of the largest rail networks in the U.S., with more than 31,000 route miles covering 27 states and two Canadian provinces.
